headline: 0.99 (and 0.97) is out of reach by 29 Sep; the plan (robust backbone + grafts from the moonshot plan) protects the private score against the x138 runtime cliff and aims at private > the 241-team x138 block (ranks ~166-406, silver ~195 and bronze ~390 both inside it) with an expected public ~0.954.
outlook: F1 = x138 + C01 runtime/fail-soft rider + C05 lowrefine + DaughterNet insertion only if #35 >= #34 (R2) + C04 forkmid after the x138-on-train audit. Expected public ~0.954 (80%: 0.953-0.955); P(public >= 0.955) ~0.25, >= 0.96 ~0.02, >= 0.97 < 0.005, 0.99 ~0. The absolute private level is set by the unseen embryos (train-embryo lab 0.90-0.92 vs public 0.947-0.953 for the same stack family; RESULTS.md), so it is not a lever. Our controllable delta vs x138 is +0.000..+0.002 (80% -0.001..+0.003), plus +0.01..+0.03 private in the slow-hidden-run world (P ~0.05-0.15 without C01; ~0.03-0.05 residual with it). P(max(F1,F2) private > x138 block) ~0.7-0.8 (guess). F2 = exp52 (guard-free, different post-ILP tail) unless F1 >= 0.954, runtime is proven comfortable and a held-out-gated variant exists. What 0.97+ would take (after the deadline): a detector (primary+secondary) retrained embryo-held-out on dense labels (dorado Ultrack for 44b6, Ultrack pseudo-labels for 6bba, optionally Zebrahub ZSNS mirrored on Kaggle, small Freitas synthetic pretrain), a debiased head refit, an edge net trained on its own detections, and a division model with honest OOF plus conditional fusion. That means >= 2-3 weeks and 50-100 GPU-h; C11 was refuted 10/10 for this window.
